candidates.label: app-host-B1-dev-swedencentral
candidates.notes: Select Consumption USD Linux Azure App Service Basic Plan B1 App, not Windows, DevTest, reservation or container execution meters. Official Linux specs: 1 vCPU, 1.75 GB RAM, 10 GB platform storage; private endpoint and separate outbound VNet integration supported. Peak 768 MiB application memory plus at least 40% platform headroom needs 1280 MiB total, below 1792 MiB. 20 RPS concentrated peak and 10–100 concurrent users are adopted planning assumptions, not validated capacity; tests by application team later. Candidate excludes common supporting resources which must be included in committed estimate. Price-only, no manifest writeback.
